plan.summary: A responsive client-side customer management website featuring a dashboard with metrics, customer records management, and real-time search capabilities, using browser storage.
plan.audience: Small business owners or freelancers who need a simple, local way to track and manage their customers.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.purpose: Provide an overview of customer metrics and quick access to recent activity.

pages.title: Customer Records
pages.purpose: List, add, edit, and delete customer profiles.

features.title: Customer Records
features.detail: Add, edit, and delete customer details such as name, email, phone, and notes.

features.title: Search and Filter
features.detail: Instantly search through customer records by name or email.

features.title: Dashboard Overview
features.detail: Display summary metrics like total customers and recent additions.

features.title: Browser Data Persistence
features.detail: Save customer records locally in the browser so data remains between sessions.

features.title: Responsive Layout
features.detail: Ensure the site works seamlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

nonGoals: Backend server deployment or cloud database storage
User authentication or multi-user access control
assumptions: The website will be published statically using GitHub Pages or a similar static host.
Data privacy is managed entirely within the user's browser using localStorage.
openQuestions: Would you like the ability to export your customer records as a CSV file?

design.layout: sidebar navigation on desktop, collapsible bottom or top bar on mobile, flexible card grids for dashboard metrics, and a responsive table/card list view for customer records.

typography.heading: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.scale: 1rem base with modular type scale for headings

design.navigation: Sidebar containing links to Dashboard and Customer Records, collapsing to a compact top/bottom bar on mobile viewports.

responsive.notes: Uses CSS Grid and Flexbox with relative units (percentages, rems, vw) to prevent horizontal scrolling and ensure seamless stacking on small screens.

engine.kind: one-shot static-site generator through the Model Gateway (writes files only; runs nothing)
engine.note: Writes the files; nothing is executed on this computer.

buildPlan.framework: Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript (no build step, no server)
buildPlan.database: None - the prototype keeps its sample data in the page
steps: Initialize the project structure with a single-page HTML layout containing navigation for dashboard and customer records.
Write CSS styles using CSS Grid and Flexbox for a responsive sidebar layout and metric cards.
Implement client-side data management using browser localStorage for customer persistence.
Build the dashboard view with summary metric counters and recent activity overview.
Implement the customer management table with modal forms for adding, editing, and deleting records.
Add real-time filtering capabilities to instantly search customer records by name or email.
